english_classification.chapter_title: Concerning the Five Forms that exist in the Rulers of Darkness
english_classification.chapter_note: This chapter is dominated by the oldest teaching substrate. It systematically maps the five forms of the ruler of Darkness onto the five worlds (fire, wind, smoke, darkness, water) using zoomorphic correspondences (lion-faced, eagle-faced, dragon-faced, fish-form, daemon-form), then enumerates two sets of three qualities/capacities. Gardner notes comparison with Chapter 6, confirming this is the same cosmological-correspondential tradition. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system throughout ¶1-11. Only ¶12-13 shift to exhortation/devotional closure addressed to 'my beloved ones.' Minimal editorial fatigue. The teaching structure is clean: five forms (¶2-3), three qualities (¶4-7), three more qualities (¶8-11), then editorial closure.
